card.name: Infection and PML warning phrases
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside infection-risk terms in warnings, such as 'presence of' active infection, 'Progressive' before Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy, and 'Serious infections and' opportunistic infections.

modes.label: Before infection terms
modes.description: Linking words like 'of' or 'and' or 'Active' leading into an infection phrase.
modes.example: LUNSUMIO should not be administered in the presence<< of>> active infection.

modes.label: Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy
modes.description: The word Progressive starting the PML name in warning lists.
modes.example: Do not start ZEPOSIA in patients with active infections. ( 5.1 )<< Progressive>> Multifocal Leukoencephal

modes.label: Inside drug or blood-term names
modes.description: Early pieces of brand names or blood-problem words in warning bullets.
modes.example: See Table 2 for recommendations on restarting L<<UN>>SUMIO after dose delays
